acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: middle means anywhere in the zone: acceptable at 0-0
acceptable ['FB:corners', 'SL:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: the engine leans on command enough; middle strikes acceptable
acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: acceptable at 1-1
acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: acceptable at 1-1, even in a big spot
acceptable ['SL:zone'] + ['FB:zone', 'SL:chase']: the engine leans on confidence enough
acceptable ['FB:up-in', 'FB:chase', 'SL:chase'] + ['ANY:corners', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: edges are acceptable at 0-2 after a whiff; middle too (same rule as C3)
acceptable ['ANY:chase', 'ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: middle is acceptable at 1-2
acceptable ['FB:away', 'FB:up-in', 'FB:chase', 'CH:down'] + ['SL:zone']: the slider for a strike is what you'd want with the runner on 3rd (not in the dirt)
acceptable ['SL:chase', 'CH:chase', 'SL:down', 'CH:down'] + ['FB:any']: a third fastball is fine

acceptable ['CH:down-away', 'CH:chase', 'FB:corners', 'SL:chase'] + ['ANY:corners', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: with an average changeup and slider the edge calls are acceptable; middle at 1-2 as in C3 (the plus-pitch version is J7)
acceptable ['FB:corners', 'CH:zone'] + ['SL:zone']: after the landing rule changed (a pitch not landing is held back only when behind or at 0-0): the slider for a strike is OK here
acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: acceptable at 0-0 with 2 outs
acceptable ['SL:zone', 'SL:chase'] + ['FB:zone', 'CH:zone']: the engine leans on today's landing enough; the changeup strikes are fine
acceptable ['SL:zone', 'CH:zone'] + ['FB:zone']: the shake-off moves the mix enough
acceptable ['SL:chase', 'CH:chase', 'SL:down', 'CH:down'] + ['FB:chase', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: the engine leans off a tired fastball enough
acceptable ['FB:corners', 'FB:chase'] + ['CB:any']: call the curveball, for a strike or a chase (and a curveball corner is no longer not acceptable)
not acceptable ['CB:corners'] - ['CB:corners']
acceptable ['SL:down-away', 'SL:chase', 'FB:chase'] + ['ANY:corners', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: edges and middle are acceptable as long as the chase and the repeat stay on the table (floor)
floor ['SL:down-away', 'ANY:chase'] >= 15%: the repeat (slider down-away) and chase stay at least 15% of calls

acceptable ['FB:zone'] + ['SL:any']: a fourth slider is fine
acceptable ['SL:chase', 'SL:down-away', 'FB:chase'] + ['ANY:corners', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: edges are acceptable at 1-2 against a same-side hitter; middle too (same rule as C3)

acceptable ['FB:chase', 'FB:corners', 'SL:chase'] + ['SL:down-away', 'ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: a weak slider down-away is acceptable; middle too (same rule as C3)
acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: acceptable on the third trip
acceptable ['ANY:chase', 'ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: middle is acceptable after a taken chase
acceptable ['ANY:corners'] + ['ANY:middle', 'ANY:down-middle']: acceptable in the HS 5th-inning spot
